key_insight: ORSMT uses exact SMT checks to detect and repair semantic mismatches between optimization models and solver code, rather than relying on matching objective values.
engineering_relevance: It adds a verification layer to LLM-generated optimization workflows by checking feasible regions and objectives before adopting repairs.
method: Align observable decisions through a typed semantic interface and project out auxiliary variables.
Prove or refute feasible-region and objective relations, localizing failures to rows or domains.
Reconstruct one artifact from another and require adopted candidates to pass the specified relation checks.
evidence_signal: Across 3,034 problems and six generator sizes, protected selection raised model-code matching from 43.2% to 88.2%, while the share both correct and matched rose from 25.2% to 40.2%.
watch_item: Model-code agreement does not establish source correctness: both artifacts can omit the same requirement.
paper_title: ORSMT: Unleashing the Potential of Satisfiability Modulo Theories for Semantic Verification and Repair in LLM-Based Optimization
